utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what book are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still deciding between a couple of titles, so I’ll bring one to the next book club and we can choose together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, that works for me. Just bring the options and I’ll help pick one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’ll need to know the time and where we’re meeting so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll confirm the time and the meeting place before you count me in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m just trying to avoid any last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Oren — book club’s still on, right? I might’ve missed the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it is, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details myself. Let me check and I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, appreciate it — I’ve been a little out of the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll let the book club folks know we’re meeting next week, and I’ll pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Let me know if anything changes before then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes before next week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what book are we discussing tonight?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—we’re talking about "The Midnight Library" tonight. I’ve got a spare copy if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate the spare copy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like to keep things simple—what’s the book club reading this week, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re reading *The Midnight Library*, and we’re meeting Thursday evening at my place—come by if you can!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll plan on Thursday evening at your place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Sam, are we meeting at my place or yours for book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Your place works great for me — I can bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, my place it is. What time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I was thinking we could pick a book that’s easy for everyone to jump into this month. Any favorites you’d want to bring up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good to me—I’d suggest something with a pretty clear plot and not too much setup. I can bring a couple of options to the club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, that’ll help a lot—I’ll bring a couple of crowd-pleasers too, and we can pick one together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m excited to hear what the book club is reading next. Let me know if you want me to bring anything or help set up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, that would be wonderful — thank you! I’ll send the book pick and time soon, and if you could help set out the chairs, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — happy to help set out the chairs. Just send me the book pick and time when you have them!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the extra chairs and some tea if the book club needs them. What book are we discussing this week?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that’s really helpful. I think we’re discussing the new mystery novel this week, but I should double-check the title.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds great — just let me know the title when you confirm it, and I’ll bring the chairs and tea.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this month, and everyone’s already got opinions. I can find out the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d be nice. I’d like to know what they’re reading before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details should I check for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you check whether the book club meets on Thursday or Friday, and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check both the day and start time for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this month — I kept hearing people mention it at the market, so I finally picked up a copy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh nice, I’ve heard that one mentioned a lot too. I’ll try to get a copy and read along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the book club details and loop everyone in with the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’d be great. I’ll wait for your update and let the others know once you do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll grab the details and share the plan with everyone soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Uli — book club’s still on, right? I almost missed whether we changed the time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s still on — I think we kept the same time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll stick with the same time then. I nearly wandered off on that one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, Gus—what book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I’ve got a copy of "The Midnight Library" if that’s the one they picked. If not, I can swing by and check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like the one to me—would you mind checking the flyer just to be sure?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help get the book club organized. What are you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I was thinking we could meet at the library next Thursday and read something short and lively — maybe a mystery or memoir.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely — the library next Thursday works for me, and a short mystery or memoir would be perfect. I can send out a few options and see what the group likes best.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to come, but I’ll need the time and place so I can plan the route.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — we’re meeting Thursday at 7 at my place, 14 Maple Street. I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me. I’ll plan to come by Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the book club meeting still happening this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should double-check the details before I say for sure, but I believe it’s still on this week.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just let me know once you’ve confirmed the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan for the book club this week—what time are we meeting, and which book should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how about we meet Thursday at 7, and bring the mystery novel if you have it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll bring the mystery novel. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting this week—what are they reading?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think they’re reading the new mystery novel this week—I can check the supply list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that’d be great. I’m always a bit behind on the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the book club! I’m pretty sure it’s tonight, unless I mixed that up with the bakery run again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think it’s tonight too — let’s check the time so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good idea — I’d rather be early than accidentally show up with pastries at the wrong place again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work if it stays after school pickup—just let me know the time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me — I’ll send the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Leo—once you have it, send it over and I’ll work it into pickup.
